title: Goldreich–Levin query budget
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $0<\tau\le1$ be a rational threshold. Every outcome in the support of the query algorithm’s run with target $f$ uses at most $4n\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil m$ membership queries, where $m=\left\lceil 2\,\mathrm{clog}_2\!\left(\left\lceil 80(n+1)(\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil+1)/\tau^2\right\rceil\right)/(\tau^4/16)\right\rceil$. Here $\mathrm{clog}_2(r)$ is the least natural number $j$ such that $r\le2^j$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
The outcome lies in the support of the algorithm’s run distribution
